description_en: Releases one or more pay-as-you-go cloud computers or expired subscription cloud computers
description_zh: 释放一台或多台按量付费云电脑或到期的包年包月云电脑
kebab_example: aliyun ecd delete-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of cloud computers. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the resource ownership in the reseller pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not in the reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid
